project_type: Offline-first desktop math/science OCR app. Two processes: Tauri v2 (Rust) + React/TS shell, and a Python 3.11 FastAPI sidecar. pnpm-workspace monorepo. This task continues milestone M1 (skeleton) from an existing worktree.
build_system: pnpm 9.15.9 workspace at the worktree root (packages: apps/*); the desktop package MUST be named `desktop` (root scripts use --filter desktop). Frontend via Vite 7. Rust via cargo 1.99.1 / Tauri CLI invoked as `pnpm --filter desktop tauri`. Engine via the venv python at engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe (Python 3.11.9). PyInstaller freezes the engine into a Tauri externalBin sidecar.
test_framework: pytest (engine, 4/4 already green), vitest (frontend), cargo test (Rust supervisor).
build_command: Frontend: `pnpm --filter desktop build`. Rust crate: `cargo build` in apps/desktop/src-tauri. Engine freeze: `python scripts/build_engine.py`. Tauri bundle: `pnpm --filter desktop tauri build`.
test_command: Frontend: `pnpm --filter desktop lint && pnpm --filter desktop test -- --run`. Rust (cwd apps/desktop/src-tauri): `cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo build`. Engine (cwd engine, venv python): `ruff check . && black --check . --line-length 100 && mypy texora_engine && pytest -q`.
